combination.distinct_rule: 按每组原始身份集合计数，不乘权重，不跨项目相加
combination.group_union: 所有入选指标出现组的并集

fact_steps.sql: SELECT f."id" AS fact_id, f."day" AS day_value, f."region" AS region_value, COALESCE(b."project", 'unassigned') AS project_value, CASE WHEN b."fact_id" IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE b.numerator END AS weight_num, CASE WHEN b."fact_id" IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE b.denominator END AS weight_den, f."amount" AS "v_amount", f."donor" AS "id_donor" FROM "donations" f LEFT JOIN "donation_projects" b ON f."id" = b."fact_id" WHERE f."day" >= ? AND f."day" < ? ORDER BY f."id", b.project

SELECT f."id" AS fact_id, f."day" AS day_value, f."region" AS region_value, COALESCE(b."project", 'unassigned') AS project_value, CASE WHEN b."fact_id" IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE b.numerator END AS weight_num, CASE WHEN b."fact_id" IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE b.denominator END AS weight_den, f."amount" AS "v_amount" FROM "expenses" f LEFT JOIN "expense_projects" b ON f."id" = b."fact_id" WHERE f."day" >= ? AND f."day" < ? ORDER BY f."id", b.project
